ex.cn: 他们需要她的时候，她却背弃了他们。

senses.chn: 脑后长眼；眼光敏锐；什么都能觉察到

ex.cn: 我在这儿长大的，我对这地方再熟悉不过了。

ex.cn: 他工作兢兢业业，值得嘉许。

to try to forget about sth unpleasant

ex.cn: 我尽量把这个念头忘掉。

ex.cn: 靠椅背坐好，放松放松。

ex.cn: 你把头发往后梳了。

ex.cn: 障碍物拦住了人群。

ex.cn: 站远点儿，给我腾出些地方。

ex.cn: 他再也无法控制住眼泪。

ex.cn: 把书放回书架上。

ex.cn: 请把我的球还给我。

ex.cn: 他星期一会回来。

ex.cn: 把肉放进冰箱里，免得坏了。

ex.cn: 你会省下五十美元，这没什么不好，对吧？

ex.cn: 她确实很想得到它。

tough and aggressive

ex.cn: 记者经常纠缠着打听她的私生活。

ex.cn: 表现差；睡得不好

ex.cn: 报酬低微；受虐待

ex.cn: 没有人愿意雇用说前雇主坏话的人。

ex.cn: 我不明白她为什么还没打电话。

senses.chn: 英国电影电视艺术学院奖

ex.cn: 一个黑色塑料垃圾袋

ex.cn: 化妆包

ex.cn: 他在楼上打开他的旅行袋取出东西。

ex.cn: 她打开手提包，取出梳子。

ex.cn: 她吃了一袋炸土豆条。

ex.cn: 他把生意全盘卖掉了。

senses.def: to have to use whatever things or people you can get, because there is not much choice available
used to emphasize how easy it is to do sth
senses.chn: 易如反掌；探囊取物；手到擒来

ex.en: What do you mean you can't do it? It'll be like shooting fish in a barrel!
ex.cn: 你说干不了是什么意思？这不是小事一桩嘛！

senses.def: to move very fast in a particular direction, especially in a way that you cannot control

ex.en: He came barreling down the hill and smashed into a phone booth.
ex.cn: 他沿山坡飞驰下来，撞进了一个电话亭。

senses.def: having a large rounded chest
senses.chn: 胸肌发达的；胸围宽大的

senses.def: a musical instrument that is played by turning a handle, usually played in the streets for money
senses.chn: 手摇风琴（街头卖艺常用）

senses.def: not good enough for plants to grow on it

ex.en: a barren desert
ex.cn: 不毛的沙漠

ex.en: a barren landscape (= one that is empty, with few plants)
ex.cn: 寸草不生的荒凉景色

senses.def: not producing fruit or seeds
not able to produce children or young animals
not producing anything useful or successful

ex.en: The team will come through this barren patch and start to win again.
ex.cn: 这个队将会在经历这段低潮时期之后再创佳绩。

senses.def: a small decorative piece of metal or plastic used by women for holding their hair in place
a line of objects placed across a road, etc. to stop people from getting past

ex.en: The police stormed the barricades the demonstrators had put up.
ex.cn: 警察冲破了示威者筑起的街垒。

senses.def: to defend or block sth by building a barricade

ex.en: They barricaded all the doors and windows.
ex.cn: 他们用障碍物堵住了所有的门窗。

senses.def: to build a barricade in front of you in order to prevent anyone from coming in

ex.en: He had barricaded himself in his room.
ex.cn: 他把自己关在房间里。

senses.def: an object like a fence that prevents people from moving forward from one place to another

ex.en: The crowd had to stand behind barriers.
ex.cn: 人群只好站在障碍物后面。

ex.en: Show your ticket at the barrier.
ex.cn: 请在验票处出示车票。

senses.def: a problem, rule or situation that prevents sb from doing sth, or that makes sth impossible

ex.en: the removal of trade barriers
ex.cn: 贸易壁垒的消除

ex.en: Lack of confidence is a psychological barrier to success.
ex.cn: 缺乏信心是阻碍成功的心理因素。

senses.def: something that exists between one thing or person and another and keeps them separate

ex.en: The Yangtze River is a natural barrier to the north-east.
ex.cn: 长江是东北面的一道天然屏障。

ex.en: the language barrier (= when people cannot communicate because they do not speak the same language)
ex.cn: 语言隔阂（因语言不通而无法交流）

ex.en: There was no real barrier between reality and fantasy in his mind.
ex.cn: 在他的头脑中，现实与幻想之间没有真正的界线。

ex.en: Ozone is the earth's barrier against ultra-violet radiation.
ex.cn: 臭氧是地球防止紫外线辐射的屏障。

senses.def: a particular amount, level or number that it is difficult to get past
senses.chn: 难以逾越的数量（或水平、数目）；关口

ex.en: the first player whose earnings passed the $10 million barrier
ex.cn: 第一位收入超过 1 000 万美元大关的运动员

senses.def: a method of avoiding becoming pregnant by stopping the sperm from reaching the egg, for example by using a condom
senses.chn: 屏障避孕法（使用避孕套等）

senses.def: a line of rock and coral in the sea, often not far from land
except for; unless there is/are

ex.en: Barring accidents, we should arrive on time.
ex.cn: 除非有意外情况，我们应可按时到达。

senses.def: a district of a city in Spain or in another Spanish-speaking country
senses.chn: （西班牙或西班牙语国家的）区

senses.def: a district of a city in the US where a lot of Spanish-speaking people live
senses.chn: （美国城市中说西班牙语的人聚居的）西语区

senses.def: a lawyer in Britain who has the right to argue cases in the higher courts of law
senses.chn: 出庭律师，大律师，辩护律师（在英国有资格出席高等法庭进行辩护）

ex.en: district attorney
ex.cn: 地方检察官

ex.en: counsel for the prosecution
ex.cn: 控方律师

ex.en: Solicitor General
ex.cn: 司法部副部长

senses.def: a room in which alcoholic drinks are served at a bar

ex.en: a topic much discussed in barrooms across the country
ex.cn: 全国各地酒吧间议论纷纷的话题

ex.en: a barroom brawl
ex.cn: 酒吧间的斗殴

senses.def: a small open vehicle with two wheels from which fruit, vegetables, etc. are sold in the street
senses.chn: 两轮流动售货车（售卖水果、蔬菜等）

senses.def: a large pile of earth built over a place where people were buried in ancient times
a man or boy who sells things from a barrow in the street
senses.chn: 街头推车售货男子（或男孩）；街头推车小贩

senses.def: a tall seat for customers at a bar to sit on
baronet
a woman who works in a bar, serving drinks
to exchange goods, property, services, etc. for other goods, etc. without using money
senses.chn: （同某人）以物易物；以财产（或劳务等）作交换

ex.en: The prisoners tried to barter with the guards for items like writing paper and books.
ex.cn: 囚犯们试着从看守那里换得信纸和书之类的东西。

ex.en: The local people bartered wheat for tools.
ex.cn: 当地人用小麦换取工具。

senses.def: forming or belonging to a bottom layer or base

ex.en: basal cells of the skin
ex.cn: 皮肤基底细胞

senses.def: a type of dark rock that comes from volcanoes
the lowest part of sth, especially the part or surface on which it rests or stands

ex.en: the base of a column/glass
ex.cn: 柱基；玻璃杯底座

ex.en: a pain at the base of the spine
ex.cn: 脊柱末端的疼痛

ex.en: The lamp has a heavy base.
ex.cn: 这盏灯的底座很沉。

ex.en: Footnotes are given at the bottom of each page.
ex.cn: 脚注附于每页的下端。

ex.en: I waited for them at the bottom of the hill.
ex.cn: 我在山脚下等他们。

ex.en: The lamp has a heavy base.
ex.cn: 这台灯的底座很沉。

senses.def: an idea, a fact, a situation, etc. from which sth is developed

ex.en: She used her family's history as a base for her novel.
ex.cn: 她以她的家族史作为小说的素材。

ex.en: His arguments have a sound economic base.
ex.cn: 他的论点有充分的经济上的根据。

ex.en: This article will form the basis for our discussion.
ex.cn: 这篇文章将作为我们讨论的基点。

ex.en: Respect and friendship provide a solid foundation for marriage.
ex.cn: 尊重和友爱是婚姻的牢固基础。

ex.en: The rumour is totally without foundation(= is not based on any facts).
ex.cn: 这谣传毫无事实根据。

ex.en: He laid the foundations of Japan's modern economy.
ex.cn: 他奠定了日本现代经济的基础。

senses.def: the people, activity, etc. from which sb/sth gets most of their support, income, power, etc.
senses.chn: （支持、收入、力量等的）来源，源泉，基础

ex.en: These policies have a broad base of support.
ex.cn: 这些政策得到广泛支持。

ex.en: an economy with a solid manufacturing base
ex.cn: 以制造业为坚实基础的经济体

senses.def: the pay that you get before anything extra is added

ex.en: All we got was base pay—we didn't reach profitability levels to award a bonus.
ex.cn: 我们只拿到了基本工资，因为没有达到可发奖金的盈利水平。

senses.def: the first or main part of a substance to which other things are added
senses.chn: 混合物的首要（或主要）成分

ex.en: a drink with a rum base
ex.cn: 主要成分为朗姆酒的饮料

ex.en: Put some moisturizer on as a base before applying your make-up.
ex.cn: 化妆前先搽些润肤霜打底。

senses.def: the main place where you live or stay or where a business operates from

ex.en: I spend a lot of time in Britain but Paris is still my base.
ex.cn: 我有很多时间在英国度过，但主要还是居住在巴黎。

ex.en: The town is an ideal base for touring the area.
ex.cn: 这个镇子是在这一地区旅游观光的理想据点。

ex.en: The company has its base in New York, and branch offices all over the world.
ex.cn: 公司总部设在纽约，分支遍及全世界。

senses.def: a place where an army, a navy, etc. operates from

ex.en: a military/naval base
ex.cn: 军事／海军基地

ex.en: an air base
ex.cn: 空军基地

ex.en: After the attack, they returned to base.
ex.cn: 他们发动攻击之后返回了基地。

senses.def: a chemical substance, for example an alkali, that can combine with an acid to form a salt
a number on which a system of counting and expressing numbers is built up, for example 10 in the decimal system and 2 in the binary system
senses.chn: 基数（如十进制的 10 和二进制的 2）

senses.def: one of the four positions that a player must reach in order to score points
completely wrong about sth

ex.en: If that's what you think, you're way off base.
ex.cn: 你如果那么想就全错了。

senses.def: to consider and deal with all the things that could happen or could be needed when you are arranging sth
to fail to make a successful start in a project, relationship, etc.; to fail to get through the first stage
senses.chn: （工程、关系等）未能顺利开始，未能跨出第一步

senses.def: to make contact with sb again
to use a particular city, town, etc. as the main place for a business, holiday/vacation, etc.
senses.chn: 以…为据点（或大本营等）；把（总部等）设在

ex.en: They decided to base the new company in York.
ex.cn: 他们决定将新成立的公司总部设在约克。

ex.en: We're going to base ourselves in Tokyo and make trips from there.
ex.cn: 我们将以东京为据点到各地旅行。

senses.def: to use an idea, a fact, a situation, etc. as the point from which sth can be developed

ex.en: What are you basing this theory on?
ex.cn: 你这理论的根据是什么？

senses.def: not having moral principles or rules

ex.en: He acted from base motives.
ex.cn: 他的行动动机卑鄙。

senses.def: a game played especially in the US by two teams of nine players, using a bat and ball. Each player tries to hit the ball and then run around four bases before the other team can return the ball.

ex.en: a baseball bat/team/stadium
ex.cn: 棒球球棒／球队／球场

ex.en: a pair of baseball boots
ex.cn: 一双棒球靴

senses.def: the ball used in this game
a cap with a long peak, originally worn by baseball (= a curved part sticking out in front), originally worn by baseball players
a narrow piece of wood that is fixed along the bottom of the walls in a house
a camp where people start their journey when climbing high mountains
if one thing is based on another, it uses it or is developed from it

ex.en: The movie is based on a real-life incident.
ex.cn: 这部电影以真实事件为蓝本。

ex.en: The report is based on figures from six different European cities.
ex.cn: 报告的依据是欧洲六个不同城市的数据。

senses.def: if a person or business is based in a particular place, that is where they live or work, or where the work of the business is done
senses.chn: 在…居住（或工作）；基地（或总部）在…

ex.en: We're based in Chicago.
ex.cn: 我们住在芝加哥。

ex.en: a Chicago-based company
ex.cn: 总部设在芝加哥的公司

senses.def: containing sth as an important part or feature
senses.chn: 以…为重要部分（或特征）；以…为主

ex.en: lead-based paints
ex.cn: 铅基涂料

ex.en: a class-based society
ex.cn: 以阶级为特征的社会

senses.def: the basic form of a word to which endings can usually be added, for example wall is the base form of walls and walled. The base form is the form in which words in the dictionary are usually shown.
senses.chn: （词的）基础形式；派生词基础式

senses.def: the sport of jumping with a parachute from a high place such as a building or a bridge
senses.chn: 高处跳伞（从建筑物、大桥等高处乘降落伞跳下）

senses.def: not supported by good reasons or facts

ex.en: The rumours were completely baseless.
ex.cn: 那些谣传毫无根据。

senses.def: a line marking each end of the court in tennis or the edge of the area where a player can run in baseball
senses.chn: （网球场的）底线；（棒球场的）垒线

senses.def: a line or measurement that is used as a starting point when comparing facts

ex.en: The figures for 2014 were used as a baseline for the study.
ex.cn: 这项研究以 2014 年的数据为基准。

senses.def: a player who defends first, second or third base
a room or rooms in a building, partly or completely below the level of the ground

ex.en: Kitchen goods are sold in the basement.
ex.cn: 厨房用具在地下室出售。

ex.en: a basement flat/apartment
ex.cn: 设在地下室的一套房间

senses.def: a metal, for example iron or lead2, that is not a precious metal such as gold
a rate of interest, set by a central bank, that banks in Britain use when calculating the amount of interest that they charge on money they lend
senses.chn: 基本利率（英国各银行使用的贷款利率，由中央银行规定）

senses.def: to hit sb/sth very hard

ex.en: He bashed her over the head with a hammer.
ex.cn: 他用锤子猛击她的头部。

ex.en: I braked too late and bashed into the car in front.
ex.cn: 我刹车太晚，撞上了前面的车。

ex.en: The boy was hit by a speeding car.
ex.cn: 男孩被超速行驶的汽车撞倒了。

ex.en: Someone had knocked a hole in the wall.
ex.cn: 有人在墙上打了个洞。

ex.en: The baby was banging the table with his spoon.
ex.cn: 婴儿用调羹敲打着桌子。

ex.en: The ship struck a rock.
ex.cn: 船触礁了。

senses.def: to criticize sb/sth strongly

ex.en: Bashing politicians is normal practice in the press.
ex.cn: 严厉批判政治人物乃是新闻界常事。

ex.en: a liberal-bashing administration
ex.cn: 打击自由主义的政府

senses.def: to continue working hard at sth

ex.en: He sat bashing away at his essay all day.
ex.cn: 他一整天都坐着不停地写文章。

ex.en: We'll never get finished at this rate. We'd better bash on.
ex.cn: 以这种速度我们永远也完成不了。我们最好加把劲。

senses.def: to destroy sth by hitting it very hard and often

ex.en: The police bashed the door down.
ex.cn: 警察使劲把门撞倒了。

ex.en: I'll bash your head in if you do that again.
ex.cn: 如果你再那么做，我就砸扁你的脑袋。

senses.def: to produce sth quickly and in large quantities, but not of very good quality

ex.en: She bashed out about four books a year.
ex.cn: 她一年大概炮制出四本书。

senses.def: to attack sb violently
a hard hit

ex.en: He gave Mike a bash on the nose.
ex.cn: 他照着迈克的鼻子狠狠地给了一下。

senses.def: a large party or celebration

ex.en: a birthday bash
ex.cn: 生日庆典

senses.def: to try to do sth, especially when you are not sure if you will succeed

ex.en: I'm not sure I'll be any good but I'll have a bash.
ex.cn: 我不敢保证我能帮上什么忙，但我会试试。

senses.def: shy and easily embarrassed
very strong criticism of a person or group

ex.en: union-bashing
ex.cn: 对工会的猛烈抨击

senses.def: a physical attack, or a series of attacks, on a person or group of people
senses.chn: （对某人或群体的）殴打，接连打击

ex.en: gay-bashing (= attacking homosexuals)
ex.cn: 对同性恋者的攻击

ex.en: to give sb a bashing
ex.cn: 痛打某人

senses.def: to attack sb violently
forming the part of sth that is most necessary and from which other things develop

ex.en: basic information/facts/ideas
ex.cn: 基本信息／事实／思想

ex.en: the basic principles of law
ex.cn: 法律的基本原则

ex.en: Drums are basic to African music.
ex.cn: 鼓是非洲音乐的基本乐器。

senses.def: of the simplest kind or at the simplest level
senses.chn: 最简单的；初级的；初步的

ex.en: The campsite provided only basic facilities.
ex.cn: 野营地只提供最基本的设施。

ex.en: My knowledge of French is pretty basic.
ex.cn: 我的法语学得很粗浅。

senses.def: necessary and important to all people

ex.en: basic human rights
ex.cn: 基本人权

ex.en: the cost of basic foods
ex.cn: 基本食粮的费用

senses.def: before anything extra is added
senses.chn: 基本的；没有附加成分的

ex.en: The basic pay of the average worker has risen by 3 per cent.
ex.cn: 工人的平均基本工资上升了 3%。

senses.def: in the most important ways, without considering things that are less important

ex.en: Yes, that's basically correct.
ex.cn: 对，基本正确。

ex.en: The two approaches are basically very similar.
ex.cn: 两种方法其实差不多。

ex.en: There have been some problems but basically it's a good system.
ex.cn: 虽然出现过一些问题，但这基本上仍不失为一个好系统。

senses.def: used when you are giving your opinion or stating what is important about a situation

ex.en: Basically, there's not a lot we can do about it.
ex.cn: 总的说来，我们能做的有限。

ex.en: He basically just sits there and does nothing all day.
ex.cn: 他根本就是一天到晚坐在那儿无所事事。

ex.en: And that's it, basically.
ex.cn: 说穿了，就是这么回事。

senses.def: a set of 850 carefully chosen words of English, used for international communication
senses.chn: 基本英语（简化国际通用语，共有 850 个词语）

senses.def: the most important and necessary facts, skills, ideas, etc. from which other things develop
senses.chn: 基本因素（或原理、原则、规律等）

ex.en: the basics of computer programming
ex.cn: 计算机编程概要

senses.def: the simplest and most important things that people need in a particular situation

ex.en: Some schools lack money for basics like books and pencils.
ex.cn: 有些学校缺少资金购买书本、铅笔之类的基本用具。

senses.def: to think about the simple or most important ideas within a subject or an activity instead of new ideas or complicated details
a plant with shiny green leaves that smell sweet and are used in cooking as a herb
senses.chn: 罗勒（叶子碧绿芳香，用于烹调）

senses.def: a form of a language that is considered to have a lower status than other forms
senses.chn: 下层方言（被认为逊于其他语言形式）

senses.def: a large church or hall with a curved end and two rows of columns inside
senses.chn: 巴西利卡，会堂（一端呈半圆形，内设两排廊柱）

senses.def: (in ancient stories) a creature like a snake, which can kill people by looking at them or breathing on them
senses.chn: 蛇怪，巴兹里斯克蛇（古代传说中目光或气息可致人死亡的怪物）

senses.def: a large round bowl for holding liquids or (in British English) for preparing foods in; the amount of liquid, etc. in a basin
senses.chn: 盆；（英式英语）调菜盆；一盆（的量）

ex.en: a pudding basin
ex.cn: 布丁盆

senses.def: an area of land around a large river with streams running down into it

ex.en: the Amazon Basin
ex.cn: 亚马孙河流域

senses.def: a place where the earth's surface is lower than in other areas of the world

ex.en: the Pacific Basin
ex.cn: 太平洋海盆

senses.def: a sheltered area of water providing a safe harbour for boats

ex.en: a yacht basin
ex.cn: 停放游艇的内港

senses.def: the reason why people take a particular action

ex.en: She was chosen for the job on the basis of her qualifications.
ex.cn: 她因资历适合而获选中担任这项工作。

ex.en: Some movies have been banned on the basis that they are too violent.
ex.cn: 有些影片因暴力镜头过多而被查禁。

ex.en: He said no but he didn't give a reason.
ex.cn: 他说不行，但没有说明原因。

ex.en: The most likely explanation is that his plane was delayed.
ex.cn: 最可能的解释是他的飞机晚点了。

ex.en: She left the room abruptly without explanation.
ex.cn: 她未作解释就突然离开了房间。

ex.en: You have no grounds for complaint.
ex.cn: 你没有理由抱怨。

senses.def: the way things are organized or arranged

ex.en: on a regular/permanent/part-time/temporary basis
ex.cn: 以定期／永久／兼职／临时性的方式

ex.en: on a daily/day-to-day/weekly basis
ex.cn: 按每天／每周一次的标准

senses.def: the important facts, ideas or events that support sth and that it can develop from

ex.en: The basis of a good marriage is trust.
ex.cn: 美满婚姻的基础是信赖。

ex.en: This article will form the basis for our discussion.
ex.cn: 这篇文章将作为我们讨论的基点。

ex.en: The theory seems to have no basis in fact.
ex.cn: 这一理论似乎没有事实根据。

ex.en: This article will form the basis for our discussion.
ex.cn: 这篇文章将作为我们讨论的基点。

ex.en: Respect and friendship provide a solid foundation for marriage.
ex.cn: 尊重和友爱是婚姻的牢固基础。

ex.en: The rumour is totally without foundation(= is not based on any facts).
ex.cn: 这谣传毫无事实根据。

senses.def: to enjoy sitting or lying in the heat or light of sth, especially the sun

ex.en: We sat basking in the warm sunshine.
ex.cn: 我们坐着享受温暖的阳光。

senses.def: to enjoy the good feelings that you have when other people praise or admire you, or when they give you a lot of attention
senses.chn: 沉浸，沐浴（在赞美、关注等中）

ex.en: He had always basked in his parents' attention.
ex.cn: 他一直沉浸在父母的呵护中。

ex.en: I never minded basking in my wife's reflected glory (= enjoying the praise, attention, etc. she got).
ex.cn: 妻子的荣耀惠及于我，我并不觉得有什么不好意思。

senses.def: a container for holding or carrying things. Baskets are made of thin strips of material that bends and twists easily, for example plastic, wire or wicker.

ex.en: a shopping basket

a heavy axe with a long handle, used in the past as a weapon
a large fast ship used in war in the past, faster and lighter than a battleship

a word or phrase used by a group of people who work together for a particular purpose, especially a political one
the uniform that soldiers wear for training and when they go to fight
a place where a battle is being fought or has been fought
a subject that people feel strongly about and argue about
(of soldiers) having experience of war and therefore effective at fighting battles

senses.chn: 伤痕累累的；满目疮痍的

ex.cn: 我觉得再待久一点我就会发疯。

ex.cn: 你们这些家伙全疯了！

a decoration for a Christmas tree in the shape of a ball
a unit for measuring the speed at which electronic signals and information are sent from one computer to another

senses.chn: 包豪斯建筑学派（20 世纪初德国建筑和设计的风格、流派，受工业界方法和材料的影响，强调实用功能）

senses.def: to be unwilling to do sth or become involved in sth because it is difficult, dangerous, etc.

ex.cn: 许多父母可能不愿出 100 美元买一双鞋。

senses.def: to stop suddenly and refuse to jump a fence, etc.
senses.chn: 逡巡不前；突然拒绝前行（如跳越障碍物等）

senses.def: to prevent sb from getting sth or doing sth

ex.en: She looked like a lion baulked of its prey.
ex.cn: 她看上去像一头吃不到猎物的狮子。

senses.def: a soft mineral from which aluminium/aluminum is obtained
a woman who was in charge of a brothel (= a house where men pay to have sex)
loud, and dealing with sex in an amusing way
senses.chn: 喧闹并猥亵作乐的；说黄色笑话的

senses.def: to shout loudly, especially in an unpleasant or angry way

ex.en: She bawled at him in front of everyone.
ex.cn: 她当着大家的面冲他大喊大叫。

ex.en: He sat in his office bawling orders at his secretary.
ex.cn: 他坐在办公室里，对秘书厉声发号施令。

ex.en: 'Get in here now!' she bawled out.
ex.cn: “马上进来！” 她嚷道。

senses.def: to cry loudly, especially in an unpleasant and annoying way

ex.en: A child was bawling in the next room.
ex.cn: 隔壁有个孩子在大声哭闹。

ex.en: He was bawling his eyes out (= crying very loudly).
ex.cn: 他正号啕大哭。

senses.def: to speak angrily to sb because they have done sth wrong

ex.en: The teacher bawled him out for being late.

senses.def: a part of the sea, or of a large lake, partly surrounded by a wide curve of the land

ex.en: the Bay of Bengal
ex.cn: 孟加拉湾

ex.en: Hudson Bay
ex.cn: 哈得孙湾

ex.cn: 海湾一带的壮观景象

senses.def: a marked section of ground either inside or outside a building, for example for a vehicle to park in, for storing things, etc.

ex.en: a parking/loading bay
ex.cn: 停车位；装货区

ex.en: Put the equipment in No 3 bay.
ex.cn: 把设备放在 3 号仓房。

a horse of a dark brown colour

ex.cn: 他骑着一匹高大的栗色马。

senses.def: a deep noise, especially the noise made by dogs when hunting
senses.chn: （尤指猎犬捕猎时的）低沉吠声

senses.def: a herb used to give flavour to food, made of the leaves of the bay tree
when an animal that is being hunted is at bay, it must turn and face the dogs and hunters because it is impossible to escape from them
senses.chn: （猎物）被围困，被迫作困兽之斗

senses.def: to prevent an enemy from coming close or a problem from having a bad effect
senses.chn: 不让（敌人）接近；防止（问题）恶化

ex.en: I'm trying to keep my creditors at bay.
ex.cn: 我在竭力避开债主。

ex.en: Charlotte bit her lip to hold the tears at bay.
ex.cn: 夏洛特咬住嘴唇不让眼泪流出来。

senses.def: to make a long deep sound, especially while hunting
senses.chn: （尤指捕猎时）发出长嗥，低沉地吠叫

ex.en: a pack of baying hounds
ex.cn: 一群不断吠叫着的猎犬

senses.def: to demand sth in a loud and angry way

ex.en: The referee's decision left the crowd baying for blood (= threatening violence towards him).
ex.cn: 裁判的裁决引起群众怒吼着要暴力相向。

senses.def: dark brown in colour

ex.en: a bay mare
ex.cn: 一匹栗色的母马

senses.def: the dried leaf of the bay tree that is used in cooking as a herb
a long, sharp knife that is fastened onto the end of a rifle and used as a weapon in battle
to push a bayonet into sb in order to kill them
a branch of a river in the southern US that moves very slowly and has many plants growing in it
a small tree with dark green leaves with a sweet smell that are used in cooking
senses.chn: 月桂树，甜月桂（叶子可作香料）

senses.def: a large window, usually with glass on three sides, that sticks out from the outside wall of a house
(in some Eastern countries) a street or an area of a town where there are many small shops
(in Britain, the US, etc.) a sale of goods, often items made by hand, to raise money for a charity or for people who need help
a long gun, shaped like a tube, which is held on the shoulder and used to fire rockets at military vehicles
a woman's breast
British Broadcasting Corporation (a national organization which broadcasts television and radio programmes and which is paid for by the public and not by advertising)

ex.en: The news is on BBC One at 6.
ex.cn: 新闻在英国广播公司电视一台 6 点钟播出。

ex.en: BBC Radio 4
ex.cn: 英国广播公司广播四台

senses.def: barbecue
bulletin board system (a system which allows a group of people to leave messages which the others in the group can read and reply to)
senses.chn: 公告板系统；留言板系统；电子布告栏系统

senses.def: before Christ (used in the Christian calendar to show a particular number of years before the year when Christ is believed to have been born)

ex.en: the third century BC

senses.def: blind carbon copy (to) (used on emails or business letters to show that a copy is being sent to another person whose name and address cannot be seen by the other person or people who receive it)
senses.chn: 密件抄送，密送（全写为 blind carbon copy (to)）

senses.def: to send a copy of a letter or email to another person whose name and email address cannot be seen by the other people who receive it

ex.en: Send an email to the head of finance and bcc me.
ex.cn: 给财务主管发一封电邮并密送给我。

ex.en: That company keeps bcc'ing promotional emails to me.
ex.cn: 那家公司不断把促销电邮密送给我。

ex.en: He now bcc'ed his boss on every email he sent to difficult clients.
ex.cn: 他现在给难缠客户每发一封电邮就密送给他老板一份。

senses.chn: 公元前（用于表示年份，用法与 BC 同）

ex.en: in (the year) 2000 BCE
ex.cn: 在公元前 2000 年

ex.en: the third century BCE
ex.cn: 公元前三世纪

senses.def: to exist; to be present

ex.en: Is there a God?
ex.cn: 上帝存在吗？

ex.en: Once upon a time there was a princess…
ex.cn: 从前有一位公主…

ex.cn: 我试打过电话，但没人接。

ex.en: There's a bank down the road.
ex.cn: 沿马路不远有一家银行。

ex.en: Was there a pool at the hotel?
ex.cn: 宾馆里有游泳池吗？

senses.def: to be located; to be in a place

ex.en: The town is three miles away.
ex.cn: 镇子距此地三英里远。

ex.en: If you're looking for your file, it's on the table.
ex.cn: 你要找的文件在桌子上。

ex.en: Mary's upstairs.
ex.cn: 玛丽在楼上。

senses.def: to happen at a time or in a place

ex.en: The party is on Friday evening.
ex.cn: 聚会定于周五晚上举行。

ex.en: The meetings are always in the main conference room.
ex.cn: 会议总是在主会议室进行。

senses.def: to remain in a place

ex.en: She has been in her room for hours.
ex.cn: 她已经在她的房间里待了几个小时了。

ex.en: They're here till Christmas.
ex.cn: 他们将在这里一直住到圣诞节。

senses.def: to attend an event; to be present in a place

ex.en: I'll be at the party.
ex.cn: 我将出席聚会。

ex.en: He'll be here soon (= will arrive soon).
ex.cn: 他很快就会到达。

senses.def: to visit or call

ex.en: I've never been to Spain.
ex.cn: 我从未去过西班牙。

ex.en: He had been abroad many times.
ex.cn: 他曾多次出国。

ex.en: Has the postman been yet?
ex.cn: 邮递员来过了吗？

ex.en: Has the mailman come yet?
ex.cn: 邮递员来过了吗？

senses.def: used to say where sb was born or where their home is
senses.chn: 出生于（某地）；来自…；是（某地的）人

ex.en: She's from Italy.
ex.cn: 她是意大利人。

senses.def: used when you are naming people or things, describing them or giving more information about them

ex.en: Today is Monday.
ex.cn: 今天是星期一。

ex.en: 'Who is that?' 'It's my brother.'
ex.cn: “那个人是谁？” “是我哥哥。”

ex.en: She's a great beauty.
ex.cn: 她是个大美人。

ex.en: Susan is a doctor.
ex.cn: 苏珊是医生。

ex.en: He wants to be (= become) a pilot when he grows up.
ex.cn: 他想长大后当飞行员。

ex.en: It's beautiful!
ex.cn: 美呀！

senses.def: used when you are describing a situation or saying what you think about it

ex.en: It was really hot in the sauna.
ex.cn: 桑拿浴的确很热。

ex.en: It's strange how she never comes to see us any more.
ex.cn: 奇怪，她怎么再也不来看我们了。

ex.en: He thinks it's clever to make fun of people.
ex.cn: 他觉得拿别人开玩笑显得聪明。

ex.en: It would be a shame if you lost it.
ex.cn: 你要是把它丢了就太可惜了。

ex.en: It's going to be a great match.
ex.cn: 这将是一场了不起的比赛。

senses.def: used to talk about time

ex.en: It's two thirty.
ex.cn: 现在是两点三十。

ex.en: It was late at night when we finally arrived.
ex.cn: 我们最后到达时已是深夜。

senses.def: used to say what sth is made of

ex.en: Is your jacket real leather?
ex.cn: 你的夹克是真皮的吗？

senses.def: used to say who sth belongs to or who it is intended for

ex.en: The money's not yours, it's John's.
ex.cn: 这钱不是你的，是约翰的。

ex.en: This package is for you.
ex.cn: 这个包裹是给你的。

senses.def: to cost

ex.en: 'How much is that dress?' 'Eighty dollars.'
ex.cn: “那条连衣裙多少钱？” “八十美元。”

senses.def: to be equal to

ex.en: Three and three is six.
ex.cn: 三加三等于六。

ex.en: How much is a thousand pounds in euros?
ex.cn: 一千英镑合多少欧元？

ex.en: Let x be the sum of a and b.
ex.cn: 设 x 为 a 加 b 之和。

ex.en: London is not England (= do not think that all of England is like London).
ex.cn: 伦敦并不等于英格兰（不要以为整个英格兰都像伦敦）。

senses.def: used to say how important sth is to sb

ex.en: Money isn't everything (= it is not the only important thing).
ex.cn: 金钱不是一切（不是唯一重要的东西）。

ex.en: A thousand dollars is nothing to somebody as rich as he is.
ex.cn: 一千美元对于像他这么富有的人来说算不上什么。

senses.def: the most important part; all that matters
senses.chn: 最重要的部分；最要紧的事

ex.en: Her career is the be-all and end-all of her existence.
ex.cn: 她的事业是她生活中至关重要的事。

senses.def: as sb/sth used to be called
senses.chn: 像以往所称呼的；作为曾用名

ex.en: Jill Davis that was (= before her marriage)
ex.cn: （婚前）姓名为吉尔 · 戴维斯

ex.en: the Soviet Union, as was
ex.cn: 旧称苏联

senses.def: used to show that you are surprised and annoyed by sth that sb has done

ex.en: Someone's been and parked in front of the entrance!
ex.cn: 有人居然把车停在大门口！

senses.def: used to say that sb/sth stopped sb/sth from happening

ex.en: If it weren't for you, I wouldn't be alive today.
ex.cn: 如果不是你，我早就死了。

senses.def: to leave sb/sth alone without disturbing them or it
senses.chn: 随…去；不打扰某人／某事物

ex.en: Leave her be, she obviously doesn't want to talk about it.
ex.cn: 别烦她了，她显然不想谈论这事。

ex.en: Let the poor dog be (= don't annoy it).
ex.cn: 别逗弄那条可怜的狗了。

senses.def: future

ex.en: his bride-to-be
ex.cn: 他的未婚妻

ex.en: mothers-to-be (= pregnant women)
ex.cn: 准妈妈

senses.def: used to show that you accept that sth negative cannot be changed
senses.chn: 事已至此（表示接受无法改变的负面事情）

ex.en: I never imagined that our company share prices would fall so low, but it is what it is.
ex.cn: 我从没想到我们公司的股价会跌到这么低，但事已至此，又能如何？

senses.def: used with a past participle to form the passive
senses.chn: （与过去分词连用构成被动语态）

ex.en: He was killed in the war.
ex.cn: 他死于这场战争。

ex.en: Where were they made?
ex.cn: 这些东西是在哪里制造的？

ex.en: The house was still being built.
ex.cn: 房子还在建造中。

ex.en: You will be told what to do.
ex.cn: 会有人告诉你该干什么的。

senses.def: used with a present participle to form progressive tenses
senses.chn: （与现在分词连用构成进行时）

ex.en: I am studying Chinese.
ex.cn: 我正在学中文。

ex.en: I'll be seeing him soon.
ex.cn: 我很快就要见到他了。

ex.en: What have you been doing this week?
ex.cn: 你这个星期都在做些什么？

ex.en: I'm always being criticized.
ex.cn: 我总是受到批评。

senses.def: used to make question tags (= short questions added to the end of statements)

ex.en: You're not hungry, are you?
ex.cn: 你不饿，对吧？

ex.en: Ben's coming, isn't he?
ex.cn: 本要来，是不是？

ex.en: The old theatre was pulled down, wasn't it?
ex.cn: 老戏院被拆了，对不？

senses.def: used to avoid repeating the full form of a verb in the passive or a progressive tense
senses.chn: （在被动语态或进行时中代替重复的动词完整形式）

ex.en: Karen wasn't beaten in any of her games, but all the others were.
ex.cn: 卡伦没有输掉任何一场比赛，但所有其他人都输过。

ex.en: 'Are you coming with us?' 'No, I'm not.'
ex.cn: “你和我们一起去吗？” “不，我不了。”

senses.def: used to say what must or should be done

ex.en: I am to call them once I reach the airport.
ex.cn: 我一到机场就得给他们打电话。

ex.en: You are to report this to the police.
ex.cn: 你应该报警。

ex.en: What is to be done about this problem?
ex.cn: 该如何处理这个问题？

senses.def: used to say what is arranged to happen

ex.en: They are to be married in June.
ex.cn: 他们计划于六月份结婚。

senses.def: used to say what happened later

ex.en: He was to regret that decision for the rest of his life (= he did regret it).
ex.cn: 他终生都会后悔作出了那一决定。

senses.def: used to say what could not or did not happen

ex.en: Anna was nowhere to be found (= we could not find her anywhere).
ex.cn: 我们到处都找不到安娜。

ex.en: He was never to see his wife again (= although he did not know it would be so at the time, he did not see her again).
ex.cn: 他注定再也见不到他的妻子了。

ex.en: She wanted to write a successful novel, but it was not to be (= it turned out never to happen).
ex.cn: 她曾想写一部成功的小说，但从未如愿。

senses.def: used to express a condition

ex.en: If we were to offer you more money, would you stay?
ex.cn: 假如我们给你加钱，你愿意留下吗？

ex.en: Were we to offer you more money, would you stay?
ex.cn: 假如我们给你加钱，你愿意留下吗？

senses.def: to make or treat sb/sth as

ex.en: Don't belittle his achievements (= say they are not important).
ex.cn: 不要贬低他的成就。

ex.en: An older girl befriended me.
ex.cn: 一个年纪大些的女孩对我很友善。

senses.def: wearing or covered with

ex.en: heavily bejewelled fingers
ex.cn: 戴满珠宝的手指

ex.en: bespattered with mud
ex.cn: 溅满污泥

senses.def: to cause sth to be

ex.en: The ship was becalmed (= there was no wind so it could not move).
ex.cn: 帆船因无风而停航。

ex.en: The rebels besieged the fort.
ex.cn: 叛乱者包围了城堡。

senses.def: used to turn intransitive into transitive verbs (= without an object) into transitive verbs (= with an object)
senses.chn: （与不及物动词结合，构成及物动词）

ex.en: She is always bemoaning her lot.
ex.cn: 她总是怪命不好。

senses.def: used to say that you think what sb has said is unfair or too critical
senses.chn: （认为某人的话有失公允或过于苛刻时说）有点言重了

be able to do sth in your sleep.lemma: be able to do sth in your sleep

senses.def: to be able to do sth very easily because you have done it many times before
to be close to doing sth; to be going to do sth very soon

ex.en: I was just about to ask you the same thing.
ex.cn: 我刚才正要问你同一件事情。

senses.def: an area of sand or small stones (called shingle), beside the sea or a lake

ex.en: tourists sunbathing on the beach
ex.cn: 在海滩上沐浴着阳光的游客

ex.en: a sandy/pebble/shingle beach
ex.cn: 细沙／卵石／砾石海滩

ex.en: a beach bar
ex.cn: 海滨酒吧

ex.en: a town on the south coast of England
ex.cn: 英格兰南海岸的一座城镇

ex.en: The coast road is closed due to bad weather.
ex.cn: 由于天气恶劣，滨海公路暂时封闭。

ex.en: That's a pretty stretch of coast.
ex.cn: 那是一段美丽的海岸线。

senses.def: to come or bring sth out of the water and onto the beach

ex.en: He beached the boat and lifted the boy onto the shore.
ex.cn: 他把小船拖上岸，把男孩抱到海岸上。

ex.en: a beached whale (= one that has become stuck on land and cannot get back into the water)
ex.cn: 搁浅在海滩上的鲸

senses.def: a large, light, coloured plastic ball that people play games with on the beach
a small car used for driving on sand
a person who walks along beaches collecting interesting or valuable things, either for pleasure or to sell
senses.chn: 海滩拾荒者（或寻宝的人）

senses.def: the part of a town facing the beach

ex.en: beachfront hotels/apartments
ex.cn: 海滨旅馆／公寓

a form of volleyball played on sand by teams of two players
clothes for wearing on the beach
a light that is placed somewhere to guide vehicles and warn them of danger
senses.chn: （指引车船等的）灯标，灯塔，立标

ex.en: a navigation beacon
ex.cn: 航标灯

ex.en: He was a beacon of hope for the younger generation.
ex.cn: 他是年轻一代的希望之灯。

senses.def: a radio station whose signal helps ships and aircraft to find their position
(in the past) a fire lit on top of a hill as a signal
used to emphasize that you think sth is extremely bad or shocking
senses.chn: （用于强调）极其糟糕，令人震惊

ex.en: It's a crying shame to waste all that food.
ex.cn: 那么些食物都浪费了，真是太不像话了。

ex.en: a necklace of wooden beads

ex.cn: 他跟那个丑女调情时一定是酒喝多了！

senses.def: a small piece of cardboard that you put under a glass, usually in a bar, etc. in order to protect the surface below
smelling of beer; influenced by the drinking of beer
senses.chn: 啤酒味的；喝啤酒所致的

senses.def: a yellow sticky substance that is produced by bees and is used especially for making candles and polish for wood
a plant with a root that is used as a vegetable, especially for feeding animals or making sugar
a plant with a round dark red root that is cooked and eaten as a vegetable
an insect, often large and black, with a hard case on its back, covering its wings. There are several types of beetle.
to move somewhere quickly

ex.en: I last saw him beetling off down the road.
ex.cn: 我上次见到他时，他正快步沿路而去。

senses.def: a plant with a round dark red root that is cooked and eaten as a vegetable
to no longer owe sb money or a favour
to happen to sb
senses.chn: 降临到（某人）头上；发生在（某人）身上

ex.en: They were unaware of the fate that was to befall them.
ex.cn: 他们并不知道即将降临到他们头上的厄运。

senses.def: to be suitable and good enough for sb/sth

ex.en: It was a lavish reception as befitted a visitor of her status.
ex.cn: 这场铺张的招待可算得正适合她这种身份的来访者。

ex.en: He lived in the style befitting a gentleman.
ex.cn: 他过的是一种与绅士相称的生活。

senses.def: to make sb confused

ex.en: Her brain was befogged by lack of sleep.
ex.cn: 她因缺乏睡眠而头脑昏沉。

senses.def: earlier than sb/sth

ex.en: before lunch
ex.cn: 午餐前

ex.en: the day before yesterday
ex.cn: 前天

ex.en: The year before last he won a gold medal, and the year before that he won a silver.
ex.cn: 他前年得了一枚金牌，大前年得了一枚银牌。

ex.en: She's lived there since before the war.
ex.cn: 她从战前起就一直住在那里。

ex.en: He arrived before me.
ex.cn: 他比我先到。

ex.en: She became a lawyer as her father had before her.
ex.cn: 像她父亲先前一样，她成了一名律师。

senses.def: used to say that sb/sth is in a position in front of sb/sth

ex.en: They knelt before the throne.
ex.cn: 他们跪在御座前。

ex.en: Before you is a list of the points we have to discuss.
ex.cn: 放在你面前的是一份我们所要讨论的要点清单。

senses.def: used to say that sb/sth is ahead of sb/sth in an order or arrangement

ex.en: Your name is before mine on the list.
ex.cn: 名单上你的名字在我之前。

ex.en: He puts his work before everything (= regards it as more important than anything else).
ex.cn: 他一切以工作为重。

senses.def: used to say that sth is facing sb in the future

ex.en: The task before us is a daunting one.
ex.cn: 我们所面临的任务令人生畏。

ex.en: The whole summer lay before me.
ex.cn: 整个夏季正等待着我。

senses.def: in the presence of sb who is listening, watching, etc.

ex.en: He was brought before the judge.
ex.cn: 他被带上法庭。

ex.en: She said it before witnesses.
ex.cn: 她当着证人的面讲出这事。

ex.en: They had the advantage of playing before their home crowd.
ex.cn: 他们有在主场观众面前比赛的优势。

senses.def: used to say how sb reacts when they have to face sb/sth
senses.chn: （表示面对某人、某事时的反应）

ex.en: They retreated before the enemy.
ex.cn: 面对敌人，他们撤退了。

senses.def: earlier than the time when

ex.en: Do it before you forget.
ex.cn: 尽早动手，免得忘了。

ex.en: Did she leave a message before she went?
ex.cn: 她走之前留言了吗？

senses.def: until

ex.en: It may be many years before the situation improves.
ex.cn: 这种状况或许要过很多年才能得到改善。

ex.en: It was some time before I realized the truth.
ex.cn: 过了很长一段时间我才悟出真相。

senses.def: used to warn or threaten sb that sth bad could happen

ex.en: Put that away before it gets broken.
ex.cn: 把它收好，免得打碎了。

senses.def: rather than

ex.en: I'd die before I apologized!
ex.cn: 我宁愿死也不道歉！

senses.def: at an earlier time; in the past; already

ex.en: You should have told me so before.
ex.cn: 你早该告诉我的。

ex.en: It had been fine the week before (= the previous week).
ex.cn: 前一个星期天气很好。

ex.en: That had happened long before (= a long time earlier).
ex.cn: 那是很早以前的事了。

ex.en: I think we've met before.
ex.cn: 我觉得我们以前见过面。

senses.def: earlier; before sth else happens or is done

ex.en: two weeks/three days/a few hours beforehand
ex.cn: 提前两星期／三天／几小时

ex.en: I wish we'd known about it beforehand.
ex.cn: 要是我们预先知道这事就好了。

before you can say jack robinson.lemma: before you can say jack robinson

senses.def: very quickly; very soon
senses.chn: 一刹那；一眨眼工夫；突然间

before you know where you are.lemma: before you know where you are

senses.def: very quickly or suddenly
senses.chn: 瞬息之间；转眼间；一下子

ex.en: We were whisked off in a taxi before we knew where we were.
ex.cn: 还没等我们弄清怎么回事，出租车就一阵风似的把我们带走了。

senses.def: to be likely to be dismissed from a job

ex.en: Who's next for the chop?
ex.cn: 下一个轮到谁被裁员？

senses.def: to be likely to be stopped or ended
to be going to be severely punished
to become a friend of sb, especially sb who needs your help
senses.chn: （尤指和需要帮助者）做朋友；友善相待

ex.en: Shortly after my arrival at the school, I was befriended by an older girl.
ex.cn: 我到学校后不久便得到了一位年龄较大的女孩友善对待。

senses.def: confused and unable to think normally

ex.en: He was befuddled by drink.
ex.cn: 他喝得迷迷糊糊的。

senses.def: to ask sb for sth especially in an anxious way because you want or need it very much

ex.en: He wants to see them beg for mercy.
ex.cn: 他想亲眼看着他们求饶。

ex.en: They begged him for help.
ex.cn: 他们向他求援。

ex.en: She begged permission to leave.
ex.cn: 她请求允许她离开。

ex.en: I managed to beg a lift from a passing motorist.
ex.cn: 我设法求得一位开车路过的人让我搭车。

ex.en: 'Give me one more chance,' he begged (her).
ex.cn: “再给我一次机会吧。” 他恳求（她）道。

ex.en: She begged him not to go.
ex.cn: 她求他别离开。

senses.def: to ask sb for money, food, etc., especially in the street

ex.en: London is full of homeless people begging in the streets.
ex.cn: 伦敦的街头到处都是无家可归的乞丐。

ex.en: a begging letter (= one that asks sb for money)
ex.cn: （要钱的）求援信

ex.en: The children were begging for food.
ex.cn: 那些孩子在讨饭。

ex.en: We managed to beg a meal from the cafe owner.
ex.cn: 我们设法向咖啡馆老板讨了一顿饭。

senses.def: if a dog begs, it sits on its back legs with its front legs in the air, waiting to be given sth
senses.chn: （狗蹲坐在后腿上将前腿抬起）等食物

senses.def: to ask sb for permission to do sth
if sth is going begging, it is available because nobody else wants it
to ask sb to forgive you for sth you have said or done
to make sb want to ask a question that has not yet been answered

ex.en: All of which begs the question as to who will fund the project.
ex.cn: 所有这一切都令人想到究竟由谁来投资该工程的问题。

senses.def: to talk about sth as if it were definitely true, even though it might not be

ex.en: These assumptions beg the question that children learn languages more easily than adults.
ex.cn: 这些假设想当然地认为儿童比成年人学习语言容易。

senses.def: used to say politely that you do not agree with sth that has just been said
used to tell sb that you are sorry for sth you have said or done

ex.en: I beg your pardon, I thought that was my coat.
ex.cn: 对不起，我还以为那是我的外衣呢。

senses.def: used to ask sb to repeat what they have just said because you did not hear

ex.en: 'It's on Duke Street.' 'I beg your pardon.' 'Duke Street.'
ex.cn: “在公爵大街上。” “请再说一遍。” “公爵大街。”

senses.def: used to tell sb that you are offended by what they have just said or by the way that they have said it

ex.en: 'Just go away.' 'I beg your pardon!'
ex.cn: “走开。” “你再说一遍！”

senses.def: to say that you are unable to do sth that you have agreed to do
senses.chn: 推辞（已答应做的事）；反悔

ex.en: He's always begging off at the last minute.
ex.cn: 他总是在最后一分钟反悔。

senses.def: used to express surprise or for emphasis
senses.chn: （表示惊奇或强调）天哪，的确呀

senses.def: to want very much to have sex
to become the father of a child

ex.en: Isaac begat Jacob.
ex.cn: 以撒生了雅各。

senses.def: to make sth happen

ex.en: Violence begets violence.
ex.cn: 暴力招致暴力。

senses.def: to be becoming old
to be becoming late

ex.en: The time's getting on—we ought to be going.
ex.cn: 时间越来越晚了，我们该走了。

senses.def: used to say that people seem to be doing sth at a younger age than they used to, or that they seem younger because you are now older
senses.chn: （表示做某事的人好像越来越年轻）

ex.en: The band's fans are getting younger.
ex.cn: 这支乐队的歌迷越来越年轻了。

ex.en: Why do police officers seem to be getting younger?
ex.cn: 为什么警察好像越来越年轻了？

senses.def: a person who lives by asking people for money or food
used with an adjective to describe sb in a particular way

ex.en: Aren't you dressed yet, you lazy beggar?
ex.cn: 你这个懒虫还没穿好衣服吗？

senses.def: people say beggars can't be choosers when there is no choice and sb must be satisfied with what is available
senses.chn: 要饭就不能嫌馊；给什么就得要什么

senses.def: wishing for sth does not make it happen
senses.chn: 想有不见得就有；愿望不等于事实

senses.def: to make sb/sth very poor

ex.en: Why should I beggar myself for you?
ex.cn: 我为什么要为你受穷？

senses.def: to be too extreme, shocking, etc. to believe/describe

ex.en: It beggars belief how things could have got this bad.
ex.cn: 真是难以置信，情况怎么会恶化到这种地步。

senses.def: very small in amount
people say beggars can't be choosers when there is no choice and sb must be satisfied with what is available
senses.chn: 要饭就不能嫌馊；给什么就得要什么

senses.def: a bowl held out by sb asking for food or money

ex.en: He is taking round the begging bowl on behalf of the party's campaign fund.
ex.cn: 他为筹集该党的竞选资金而四处求助。

senses.def: to start doing sth; to do the first part of sth

ex.en: Shall I begin?
ex.cn: 我可以开始了吗？

ex.en: Let's begin at page 9.
ex.cn: 咱们从第 9 页开始。

ex.en: She began by thanking us all for coming.
ex.cn: 她首先对我们大家的到来表示感谢。

ex.en: We began work on the project in May.
ex.cn: 我们于五月份启动这个项目。

ex.en: I began (= started reading) this novel last month and I still haven't finished it.
ex.cn: 我上月就开始读这本小说，到现在还没读完。

ex.en: He always begins his lessons with a warm-up exercise.
ex.cn: 他讲课前总是先让学生做预备练习题。

senses.def: to start to happen or exist, especially from a particular time

ex.en: When does the concert begin?
ex.cn: 音乐会什么时间开始？

ex.en: Work on the new bridge is due to begin in September.
ex.cn: 新桥定于九月份动工。

ex.en: The evening began well.
ex.cn: 晚会开始得很顺利。

ex.en: What time does the concert start/begin?
ex.cn: 音乐会什么时候开场？

ex.en: She started/began working here three months ago.
ex.cn: 她三个月前开始在这儿工作。

ex.en: The story begins on the island of Corfu.
ex.cn: 故事从科孚岛上开始。

senses.def: to be sth first, before becoming sth else

ex.en: He began as an actor, before starting to direct films.
ex.cn: 他先是当演员，后来开始执导影片。

ex.en: What began as a minor scuffle turned into a full-scale riot.
ex.cn: 最初的小冲突演变成了大规模的暴乱。

senses.def: to have sth as the first part or the point where sth starts

ex.en: Where does Europe end and Asia begin?
ex.cn: 欧洲和亚洲的交界处在哪里？

ex.en: Use 'an' before words beginning with a vowel.
ex.cn: 在以元音开始的词之前使用 an。

ex.en: 'I'm thinking of a country in Asia.' 'What does it begin with (= what is the first letter)?'
ex.cn: “我想的是一个亚洲国家。” “它的首字母是什么？”

ex.en: Each chapter begins with a quotation.
ex.cn: 每一章的开头都有一条引语。

ex.en: The path begins at Livingston village.
ex.cn: 这条小路始于利文斯顿村。

senses.def: to start speaking

ex.en: 'Ladies and gentlemen,' he began, 'welcome to the Town Hall.'
ex.cn: 他开始讲话：“女士们、先生们，欢迎光临市政厅。”

senses.def: to start or make sth start for the first time

ex.en: The school began in 1920, with only ten pupils.
ex.cn: 这所学校创建于 1920 年，当时只有十名学生。

ex.en: He began a new magazine on post-war architecture.
ex.cn: 他创办了一份专论战后建筑的新杂志。

senses.def: to make no attempt to do sth or have no chance of doing sth

ex.en: I can't begin to thank you enough.
ex.cn: 我说不尽对你的感激。

ex.en: He didn't even begin to understand my problem.
ex.cn: 他甚至没有弄明白我的问题。

senses.def: at first

ex.en: I found it tiring to begin with but I soon got used to it.
ex.cn: 我起初觉得很累，但不久便适应了。

ex.en: We'll go slowly to begin with.
ex.cn: 我们开始时会慢慢来的。

senses.def: used to introduce the first point you want to make

ex.en: 'What was it you didn't like?' 'Well, to begin with, our room was far too small.'
ex.cn: “你不喜欢的是什么呢？” “嗯，首先是，我们的屋子太小了。”

senses.def: you should help and care for your own family, etc. before you start helping other people
a person who is starting to learn sth and cannot do it very well yet

ex.en: She's in the beginners' class.
ex.cn: 她在初级班。

senses.def: good luck or unexpected success when you start to do sth new
senses.chn: 新手的好运；生手的意外成功

senses.def: the time when sth starts; the first part of an event, a story, etc.

ex.en: We're going to Japan at the beginning of July.
ex.cn: 我们七月初要去日本。

ex.en: She's been working there since the beginning of last summer.
ex.cn: 她自从去年夏初起就一直在那里工作。

ex.en: We missed the beginning of the movie.
ex.cn: 我们错过了电影的开头部分。

ex.en: Let's start again from the beginning.
ex.cn: 让我们再从头开始。

ex.en: The birth of their first child marked the beginning of a new era in their married life.
ex.cn: 第一个孩子的出世使他们的婚姻生活开始了一个新阶段。

ex.en: I've read the whole book from beginning to end and still can't understand it.
ex.cn: 我把整本书从头到尾看了一遍，但还是没看懂。

senses.def: the first or early ideas, signs or stages of sth
senses.chn: 原始思想；前兆；初级阶段

ex.en: Did democracy have its beginnings in ancient Greece?
ex.cn: 民主制度发端于古希腊吗？

ex.en: He built up his multimillion-pound music business from small beginnings.
ex.cn: 他从小本生意起步，逐步建立起了数百万英镑的音乐企业。

senses.def: the first sign of sth ending
senses.chn: 结束的前兆；结局的开始

senses.def: to be told that you must leave your job or that a relationship you are having with sb is over
senses.chn: 被解雇；被抛弃；（和某人的关系）被解除

senses.def: to ask sb for permission to do sth
to give all your attention to sth; to stay very close to sth
senses.chn: 全神贯注看着某物；离某物很近

ex.en: He spends every evening glued to the TV.
ex.cn: 他每天晚上都泡电视。

ex.en: Her eyes were glued to the screen (= she did not stop watching it).
ex.cn: 她目不转睛地盯着屏幕。

senses.def: to say that you are unable to do sth that you have agreed to do
senses.chn: 推辞（已答应做的事）；反悔

ex.en: He's always begging off at the last minute.
ex.cn: 他总是在最后一分钟反悔。

senses.def: if sth is going begging, it is available because nobody else wants it
to be offered for sale at a lower price than usual
to be doing sth quickly and successfully

ex.en: Work is going great guns now.
ex.cn: 目前工作很顺利。

senses.def: to be getting more and more successful in your life or career

ex.en: a young architect who's really going places
ex.cn: 一个春风得意的青年建筑师

senses.def: used to show what sb intends to do in the future

ex.en: We're going to buy a house when we've saved enough money.
ex.cn: 我们打算攒够钱后买所房子。

senses.def: used to show that sth is likely to happen very soon or in the future
senses.chn: 快要发生某事；某事将要发生

ex.en: I think I'm going to faint.
ex.cn: 我看我快昏倒了。

ex.en: If the drought continues there's going to be a famine.
ex.cn: 如果旱灾继续下去很可能要发生饥荒。

senses.def: to be in a situation where you are successful or do not have any problems
senses.chn: 大功告成；大获成功；一帆风顺

ex.en: He thinks once he gets the money he'll be golden.
ex.cn: 他认为只要拿到钱就万事大吉了。

senses.def: a way of telling sb to go away immediately
a plant with large shiny flowers that may be pink, red, yellow or white, grown indoors or in a garden
(of a thing) to be prepared and ready for use; (of a person) to be prepared and ready to do something

ex.en: By tomorrow afternoon the document will be good to go.
ex.cn: 到明天下午文件就可以备妥。

ex.en: I've spent several months training for this race so now I'm good to go.
ex.cn: 为了这场比赛我花了几个月的时间训练，现在我准备好了。

senses.def: to be skilful at making or doing things with your hands
used to express surprise
to feel unhappy that sb has sth because you do not think that they deserve it
senses.chn: 嫉妒；对（某人所享有的）感到不满

ex.en: You surely don't begrudge him his happiness.
ex.cn: 你该不是嫉妒他的幸福吧。

ex.en: I don't begrudge her being so successful.
ex.cn: 我并没有因她如此成功而怏怏不乐。

senses.def: to feel unhappy about having to do, pay or give sth
senses.chn: 勉强做；不乐意地做（或付出）

ex.en: I begrudge every second I spent trying to help him.
ex.cn: 我为了帮助他而花掉的每一秒钟都令我不痛快。

ex.en: They begrudge paying so much money for a second-rate service.
ex.cn: 花这么多的钱，却得到二流的服务，这使他们十分不快。

senses.def: to ask sb to forgive you for sth you have said or done
to make sb want to ask a question that has not yet been answered

ex.en: All of which begs the question as to who will fund the project.
ex.cn: 所有这一切都令人想到究竟由谁来投资该工程的问题。

senses.def: to talk about sth as if it were definitely true, even though it might not be

ex.en: These assumptions beg the question that children learn languages more easily than adults.
ex.cn: 这些假设想当然地认为儿童比成年人学习语言容易。

senses.def: to be certain to have a particular result

ex.en: If we try to keep it a secret, she's guaranteed to find out.
ex.cn: 如果我们试图保密，她肯定会发现。

ex.en: That kind of behaviour is guaranteed to make him angry.
ex.cn: 那样的行为肯定会让他生气。

ex.en: It's certain that they will agree.
ex.cn: 他们肯定会同意。

ex.en: They are certain to agree.
ex.cn: 他们肯定会同意。

ex.en: There are bound to be changes when the new system is introduced.
ex.cn: 新系统引进后肯定会有变化。

ex.en: You've done so much work—you're bound to pass the exam.
ex.cn: 你下了这么大功夫，一定能通过考试。

senses.def: to trick sb into doing sth, especially by being nice to them

ex.en: She beguiled them into believing her version of events.
ex.cn: 她哄骗他们相信了她叙述的事情。

senses.def: to attract or interest sb

ex.en: He was beguiled by her beauty.
ex.cn: 他为她的美丽所倾倒。

senses.def: attractive and interesting but sometimes mysterious or trying to trick you
senses.chn: 迷人的；诱人的；诱骗的；难以琢磨的

ex.en: beguiling advertisements
ex.cn: 富有诱惑力的广告

ex.en: Her beauty was beguiling.
ex.cn: 她的美有种蛊惑力。

senses.def: a title of respect used for a Muslim woman of high rank and for a married Muslim woman
senses.chn: （对穆斯林贵妇或已婚妇女的尊称）贵夫人

ex.en: Begum Zia
ex.cn: 齐亚夫人

senses.def: to be looking for an opportunity to blame or attack sb
to be competing for or trying hard to get sth
senses.chn: 竭力谋求，力图获取，寻求（某物）

ex.en: She's gunning for the top job.
ex.cn: 她正竭力谋取最高职位。

senses.def: in order to help sb

ex.en: We collected money in behalf of the homeless.
ex.cn: 我们为帮助无家可归者而募捐。

senses.def: as the representative of sb or instead of them

ex.en: On behalf of the department I would like to thank you all.
ex.cn: 我谨代表全系感谢大家。

ex.en: Mr Knight cannot be here, so his wife will accept the prize on his behalf.

ex.cn: 她知道警方将追查他们。

ex.cn: 她在新工作中将大有作为。

ex.en: He bequeathed his daughter his entire estate.
ex.cn: 他把全部财产遗赠给他的女儿。

senses.def: to leave the results of your work, knowledge, etc. for other people to use or deal with, especially after you have died
senses.chn: （尤指死后）将（工作成果、知识等）留下（给后人享用或处理）

senses.def: money or property that you ask to be given to a particular person when you die

ex.en: He left a bequest to each of his grandchildren.
ex.cn: 他给他的孙子孙女每人留下一笔遗产。

ex.cn: 刚刚痛失亲人的家庭

senses.def: a person who is bereaved

ex.cn: 为死者亲友提供辅导的组织

senses.def: the state of having lost a relative or close friend because they have died

ex.cn: 诸如离婚或痛失亲人等的情感危机的痛苦

senses.def: the death of a relative or close friend

ex.cn: 他家里有人去世了，所以不能出席会议。

ex.cn: 他弄清楚我去过哪儿后勃然大怒。

ex.cn: 船停泊在南安普敦。

senses.chn: 某人的职责范围（或知识范围）

ex.cn: 这事别问我，那是她的职责范围。

ex.cn: 我这几个孩子就是我的命根子。

ex.en: Writing is his life.
ex.cn: 写作是他的生命。

senses.chn: （认为某人的行为不明智）是某人自己的责任，是某人自己的事

ex.cn: 他要乱花钱，那是他自己的事。

ex.cn: 要想理个好发型，你最好是去找戴维。

senses.def: used to say that sb has a lot of a particular quality

ex.cn: 我的最大特点就是有耐心！

senses.def: to be sb's responsibility or business

ex.en: I'm afraid geography is not my strong suit.
ex.cn: 恐怕地理不是我的强项。

ex.cn: 求求你让他走吧！

ex.cn: 这个队整个赛季都因队员受伤而受困扰。

ex.cn: 那是困扰我们现代生活方式的一个最棘手的问题。

ex.cn: 夜里我吐了三次。

ex.cn: 坐到我旁边来。

ex.cn: 我想我星期六不会来。我有好多事要做。再说，我不太喜欢社交聚会。

ex.cn: 同你的相比，我的画显得很幼稚。

ex.cn: 是的，我知道那是个事故，可是这无关紧要。

ex.cn: 除了当医生之外，他在业余时间还写小说。

ex.cn: 除了父母外，我没有其他亲人。

ex.cn: 除足球外你还喜欢哪些运动？

ex.cn: 除足球外我喜欢所有的运动。

ex.cn: 除足球外你还喜欢哪些运动？

ex.cn: 我并不真的想去，而且现在太晚了。

ex.cn: 讲两种语言的儿童比只讲一种语言的儿童智商测试得分更高。此外／而且，讲两种语言的儿童似乎在学习第三种甚至第四种语言时觉得更容易。

ex.cn: 学习另一种语言不仅可以提升儿童未来的职业前景，而且可以增强他们的自尊心。

ex.cn: 教儿童第二语言可以提升他们未来的职业前景。此外，还可以使他们获得更强的自尊心、对其他文化更包容。

ex.cn: 另一个鼓励双语教育的原因是它能增强儿童的自尊心。

ex.en: Studies suggest that bilingual children find it easier to learn additional languages. There is, moreover, increasing evidence that bilingual children perform better across a range of school subjects, not just foreign languages.
ex.cn: 研究表明，讲两种语言的儿童学习其他语言觉得更容易。此外，越来越多的证据表明，讲两种语言的儿童不仅在外语学习上，同时在其他各门学科的学习上都表现得更好。

ex.cn: 电视、立体声音响设备以及很多其他货品的折扣

ex.cn: 巴黎被围困了四个月后被迫投降。

ex.cn: 歌迷们围着售票处，试图买到音乐会的票。

ex.cn: 那位女演员在机场被记者团团围住。

senses.def: to be very easy or plain

ex.cn: 几小时内票就卖光了。

ex.cn: 本周的演出门票全部售完。

ex.cn: 那是我看过的最棒的电影！

ex.cn: 她是同辈中最出色的网球运动员之一。

ex.cn: 那是你最漂亮的一套衣服吗？

ex.cn: 他们从孩提时起就是最要好的朋友。

ex.cn: 公司有史以来最大的成就

ex.cn: 我们想让孩子们接受尽可能最好的教育。

ex.cn: 那些年是我一生最幸福的时光。

ex.cn: 他是担任这项工作的最佳人选。

ex.cn: 排水性好的土壤最适合于这种植物。

ex.cn: 他早上工作效率最高。

ex.cn: 英国最佳穿戴女士

ex.cn: 这些海滩很美，最妙的是游客稀少。

ex.cn: 作画的最佳时间是白天。

ex.cn: 你觉得怎么好，就怎么办吧。

ex.cn: 我们将尽力处理。

senses.def: the most excellent thing or person

ex.cn: 我们都想给孩子提供最好的条件。

ex.cn: 他们只买最好的。

ex.cn: 他们都是优秀运动员，而她更是其中的佼佼者。

ex.cn: 她总是让人表现出最优秀的品质。

ex.cn: 这个小镇在春天景色最美。
