senses.def: news that people tell each other that may or may not be true
to telephone sb

ex.en: I'll give you a buzz on Monday, OK?
ex.cn: 我星期一给你打电话行吗？

senses.def: a large European bird of prey of the hawk (= a bird that kills other creatures for food) of the hawk family
a large American bird like a vulture that eats the flesh of animals that are already dead
a style of cutting the hair in which all the hair is cut very short, close to the skin of the head
senses.chn: 寸头发型（头发理得很短，贴近头皮）

senses.def: an electrical device that produces a buzzing sound as a signal
at the end of a game or period of play
senses.chn: 比赛结束时；游戏结束时

ex.en: He missed a three-point attempt at the buzzer.
ex.cn: 终场哨响时，他投三分球未中。

senses.def: one of the small groups of people that a large group can be divided into in order to discuss and give their opinions about a particular subject. The information obtained is used by people doing market research.
senses.chn: 蜂议小组，大家说小组（由大团体划分而成，组员讨论某一问题并各抒己见，意见用于市场研究）

senses.def: used to tell sb rudely to go away

ex.en: Just buzz off and let me get on with my work.
ex.cn: 走开，我得继续干活了。

senses.def: a word or phrase, especially one connected with a particular subject, that has become fashionable and popular and is used a lot in newspapers, etc.
senses.chn: （报刊等的）时髦术语，流行行话

senses.def: a word used in parts of E Africa to address a man who has authority over you, for example your employer
senses.chn: （东非部分地区用以称呼上司）主人，老板

senses.def: near sb/sth; at the side of sb/sth; beside sb/sth

ex.en: a house by the river
ex.cn: 河边的一所房子

ex.en: The telephone is by the window.
ex.cn: 电话在窗户旁边。

ex.en: Come and sit by me.
ex.cn: 过来挨着我坐。

senses.def: used, usually after a passive verb, to show who or what does, creates or causes sth
senses.chn: （常置于表示被动的动词后，表示施事者）

ex.en: He was knocked down by a bus.
ex.cn: 他被公共汽车撞倒了。

ex.en: a play by Ibsen
ex.cn: 易卜生写的剧本

ex.en: Who's that book by?
ex.cn: 谁是那本书的作者？

ex.en: I was frightened by the noise.
ex.cn: 我被那响声吓坏了。

senses.def: used for showing how or in what way sth is done

ex.en: The house is heated by gas.
ex.cn: 这房子是煤气供暖的。

ex.en: May I pay by credit card?
ex.cn: 我能用信用卡付款吗？

ex.en: I will contact you by letter.
ex.cn: 我会给你写信联系的。

ex.en: to travel by boat/bus/car/plane
ex.cn: 乘船／公共汽车／轿车／飞机

ex.en: to travel by air/land/sea
ex.cn: 坐飞机；经陆路／海路

ex.en: Switch it on by pressing this button.
ex.cn: 按下这个开关启动它。

senses.def: used before particular nouns without the, to say that sth happens as a result of sth
senses.chn: （置于不带 the 的名词前，表示原因）由于

ex.en: They met by chance.
ex.cn: 他们不期而遇。

ex.en: I did it by mistake.
ex.cn: 我误做了这事。

ex.en: The coroner's verdict was 'death by misadventure'.
ex.cn: 验尸官判定是 “意外致死”。

senses.def: not later than the time mentioned; before

ex.en: Can you finish the work by five o'clock?
ex.cn: 你五点钟前能完成工作吗？

ex.en: I'll have it done by tomorrow.
ex.cn: 我明天之前让人把它弄好。

ex.en: By this time next week we'll be in New York.
ex.cn: 下星期的这个时候我们将在纽约。

ex.en: He ought to have arrived by now/by this time.
ex.cn: 他现在应该已经到了。

ex.en: By the time (that) this letter reaches you I will have left the country.
ex.cn: 你收到这封信时，我已离开这个国家了。

senses.def: past sb/sth

ex.en: He walked by me without speaking.
ex.cn: 他一言不发地从我身边走过。

senses.def: during sth; in a particular situation

ex.en: to travel by day/night
ex.cn: 白天／夜间旅行

ex.en: We had to work by candlelight.
ex.cn: 我们不得不借助烛光工作。

senses.def: used to show the degree or amount of sth

ex.en: The bullet missed him by two inches.
ex.cn: 子弹只差两英寸就击中他了。

ex.en: House prices went up by 10%.
ex.cn: 房价上涨了 10%。

ex.en: It would be better by far (= much better) to…
ex.cn: 那比…好得多。

senses.def: from what sth shows or says; according to sth

ex.en: By my watch it is two o'clock.
ex.cn: 我的表是两点钟。

ex.en: I could tell by the look on her face that something terrible had happened.
ex.cn: 从她的脸色我可以看出，发生了可怕的事情。

ex.en: By law, you are a child until you are 18.
ex.cn: 按照法律规定，18 岁之前是未成年人。

senses.def: used to show the part of sb/sth that sb touches, holds, etc.
senses.chn: （表示触及或抓住的人或物的部分）

ex.en: I took him by the hand.
ex.cn: 我拉着他的手。

ex.en: She seized her by the hair.
ex.cn: 她揪住她的头发。

ex.en: Pick it up by the handle!
ex.cn: 抓着手柄把它提起来！

senses.def: used with the to show the period or quantity used for buying, selling or measuring sth
senses.chn: （与 the 连用，表示时间或量度单位）

ex.en: We rented the car by the day.
ex.cn: 我们按日租用汽车。

ex.en: They're paid by the hour.
ex.cn: 他们的报酬是按小时计算的。

ex.en: We only sell it by the metre.
ex.cn: 我们只按米出售。

senses.def: used to state the rate at which sth happens

ex.en: They're improving day by day.
ex.cn: 他们在一天天地改进。

ex.en: We'll do it bit by bit.
ex.cn: 我们会一点一点地做。

ex.en: It was getting worse by the minute (= very fast).
ex.cn: 情况急速恶化。

ex.en: The children came in two by two (= in groups of two).
ex.cn: 孩子们一对一对地走了进来。

senses.def: used to show the measurements of sth

ex.en: The room measures fifteen feet by twenty feet.
ex.cn: 房间 15 英尺宽 20 英尺长。

senses.def: used when multiplying or dividing

ex.en: 6 multiplied by 2 equals 12.
ex.cn: 6 乘以 2 等于 12。

ex.en: 6 divided by 2 equals 3.
ex.cn: 6 除以 2 等于 3。

senses.def: used for giving more information about where sb comes from, what sb does, etc.
senses.chn: （补充有关出生地、职业等的信息）

ex.en: He's German by birth.
ex.cn: 他是德国血统的。

ex.en: They're both doctors by profession.
ex.cn: 他们两人的职业都是医生。

senses.def: used when swearing to mean 'in the name of'

ex.en: I swear by Almighty God…
ex.cn: 我以全能上帝之名发誓…

senses.def: past

ex.en: Just drive by. Don't stop.
ex.cn: 直接开过去。别停车。

ex.en: He hurried by without speaking to me.
ex.cn: 他没和我说话就匆匆过去了。

ex.en: Excuse me, I can't get by.
ex.cn: 劳驾，请让开点路。

ex.en: Time goes by so quickly.
ex.cn: 时光飞逝。

senses.def: used to say that sth is saved so that it can be used in the future

ex.en: I've put some money by for college fees.
ex.cn: 我已经存了些钱作大学学费。

senses.def: in order to visit sb for a short time

ex.en: I'll come by this evening and pick up the books.
ex.cn: 我今晚过来取书。

senses.def: before long; soon

ex.en: By and by she met an old man with a beard.
ex.cn: 她不久就碰到了一个大胡子老头。

senses.def: used when you are saying something that is generally, but not completely, true

ex.en: By and large, I enjoyed my time at school.
ex.cn: 总的说来，我在学校的日子很开心。

ex.en: Women generally earn less than men.
ex.cn: 女人通常比男人挣钱少。

ex.en: Generally speaking, jobs traditionally done by women are paid at a lower rate than those traditionally done by men.
ex.cn: 一般来说，传统上由妇女干的工作比传统上由男人干的工作报酬低。

ex.en: In general / By and large, women do not earn as much as men.
ex.cn: 总的说来，女人不如男人挣钱多。

ex.en: Certain jobs, like nursing and cleaning, are still mainly carried out by women.
ex.cn: 有些工作仍然主要由女性做，比如护理和保洁。

ex.en: Senior management posts are predominantly held by men.
ex.cn: 高层管理职位大多由男性担任。

senses.def: less important

ex.en: a by-product
ex.cn: 副产品

senses.def: near

ex.en: a bystander
ex.cn: 旁观者

senses.def: in a way that is not planned or organized

ex.en: We met by accident at the airport.
ex.cn: 我们在机场不期而遇。

ex.en: Helen got into acting purely by accident.
ex.cn: 海伦当演员完全出于偶然。

senses.def: used to say that you are very willing for sb to have sth or do sth

ex.en: 'Do you mind if I have a look?' 'By all means.'
ex.cn: “我看一眼行吗？” “当然可以。”

senses.def: by a great amount
before long; soon

ex.en: By and by she met an old man with a beard.
ex.cn: 她不久就碰到了一个大胡子老头。

senses.def: used when you are saying something that is generally, but not completely, true

ex.en: By and large, I enjoyed my time at school.
ex.cn: 总的说来，我在学校的日子很开心。

ex.en: Women generally earn less than men.
ex.cn: 女人通常比男人挣钱少。

ex.en: Generally speaking, jobs traditionally done by women are paid at a lower rate than those traditionally done by men.
ex.cn: 一般来说，传统上由妇女干的工作比传统上由男人干的工作报酬低。

ex.en: In general / By and large, women do not earn as much as men.
ex.cn: 总的说来，女人不如男人挣钱多。

ex.en: Certain jobs, like nursing and cleaning, are still mainly carried out by women.
ex.cn: 有些工作仍然主要由女性做，比如护理和保洁。

ex.en: Senior management posts are predominantly held by men.
ex.cn: 高层管理职位大多由男性担任。

senses.def: if a person or an animal wins a race by a neck, they win it by a short distance
used especially in questions, to ask whether sth is true, possible, etc.
senses.chn: （尤用于问句，询问是否真实、可能等）或许，可能

ex.en: Are you in love with him, by any chance?
ex.cn: 或许你爱上他了？

senses.def: by a very small amount
fish that are caught by ships by accident when other types of fish are being caught
senses.chn: 误捕的鱼（捕捞其他种类的鱼时意外捕获）

ex.en: Thousands of small fish are thrown back into the sea as bycatch.
ex.cn: 成千上万误捕的鱼扔回大海中去了。

senses.def: because you have chosen

ex.en: I wouldn't go there by choice.
ex.cn: 让我选择，我不会去那里。

senses.def: used especially at the beginning of a sentence when the next thing that is mentioned is compared with sth in the previous sentence

ex.en: By comparison, expenditure on education increased last year.
ex.cn: 相比之下，去年教育经费增加了。

senses.def: a game or competition can be won by default if there are no other people, teams, etc. taking part
senses.chn: （比赛）因其他参赛者不到场，由于对手缺席（而胜出）

senses.def: if sth happens by default, it happens because you have not made any other decision or choices which would make things happen in a different way
senses.chn: 由于没有特别作出决定（或选择）

senses.def: slowly and gradually

ex.en: By degrees their friendship grew into love.
ex.cn: 他们的友谊逐渐发展成为爱情。

senses.def: goodbye

ex.en: Bye! See you next week.
ex.cn: 再见！下星期再会。

ex.en: She waved bye-bye and got into the car.
ex.cn: 她挥手道别后就钻进了汽车。

ex.en: Bye for now Dad!
ex.cn: 再见了老爸！

senses.def: a situation in which a player or team does not have an opponent in one part of the competition and continues to the next part as if they had won
senses.chn: 轮空（参赛者无对手而自动进入下一轮比赛）

ex.en: By the way, I found that book you were looking for.
ex.cn: 顺便提一下，我找到了你在寻找的那本书。

ex.en: What's the time, by the way?
ex.cn: 顺便问一句，几点钟了？

ex.en: Oh by the way, if you see Jackie, tell her I'll call her this evening.
ex.cn: 啊，对了，你要是看到杰基，告诉她我今晚给她打电话。

senses.def: used by small children or to small children, to mean 'go to sleep'
an election of a new Member of Parliament to replace sb who has died or left parliament
taking the argument or situation one stage further

ex.en: The blame lies with the teachers and, by extension, with the Education Service.
ex.cn: 应受指责的是教师，再则就是教育机构。

senses.def: using dishonest methods if honest ones do not work
by a great amount

ex.en: The last of these reasons is by far the most important.
ex.cn: 这些理由中最后一条比其他的重要得多。

ex.en: Amy is the smartest by far.
ex.cn: 埃米显然最聪明。

senses.def: happening or existing a long time ago

ex.en: a bygone age/era
ex.cn: 一个过去的时代／历史时期

senses.def: to decide to forget about disagreements that happened in the past
senses.chn: 过去的事就让它过去吧

senses.def: by a person rather than a machine

ex.en: The fabric was painted by hand.
ex.cn: 这个织品是手染的。

senses.def: if a letter is delivered by hand, it is delivered by the person who wrote it, or sb who is sent by them, rather than by post/mail
using only your memory

ex.en: I've dialled the number so many times I know it by heart.
ex.cn: 这个号码我拨了很多次，都记住了。

ex.en: She's learnt the whole speech off by heart.
ex.cn: 她把整篇讲话都背熟了。

senses.def: here; to here

ex.en: Come by here now!
ex.cn: 现在到这儿来！

senses.def: using any method you can, even a dishonest one
used to show surprise or determination
senses.chn: （表示惊讶或决心）天哪，嘿，加油啊

senses.def: used to express surprise or to emphasize a statement
senses.chn: （表示惊奇或加强语气）啊，哎呀

senses.def: a law that is made by a local authority and that applies only to that area
a law or rule of a club or company
a line at the beginning or end of a piece of writing in a newspaper or magazine that gives the writer's name
using a method of choosing sb to do sth in which each person takes a piece of paper, etc. from a container and the one whose paper has a special mark is chosen
when sb is related to you by marriage, they are married to sb in your family, or you are married to sb in their family
with the help of sth

ex.en: The load was lifted by means of a crane.
ex.cn: 重物是用起重机吊起来的。

senses.def: by accident; without intending to

ex.en: I took your bag instead of mine by mistake.
ex.cn: 我不巧错拿了你的包。

senses.def: using the name of sb/sth

ex.en: She asked for you by name.
ex.cn: 她点名要找你。

ex.en: The principal knows all the students by name.
ex.cn: 校长能叫出所有学生的姓名。

ex.en: I only know her by name (= I have heard about her but I have not met her).
ex.cn: 我只是听说过她的名字。

senses.def: a name given to sb who has the same first name as sb else, so that it is clear who is being referred to
not at all

ex.en: She is by no means an inexperienced teacher.
ex.cn: 她绝不是个毫无经验的教师。

ex.en: We haven't won yet, not by any means.
ex.cn: 我们离成功还远着呢。

by no stretch of the imagination.lemma: by no stretch of the imagination

senses.def: used to say strongly that sth is not true, even if you try to imagine or believe it
senses.chn: 任凭怎么想也不；再怎么说也不

ex.en: She could not, by any stretch of the imagination, be called beautiful.
ex.cn: 再怎么说，她也称不上漂亮。

senses.def: following a set of simple instructions identified by numbers

ex.en: painting by numbers
ex.cn: 按数字顺序着色

senses.def: (used in invitations to parties, notices in restaurants, etc.) bring your own (bottle/beer)
senses.chn: 自带酒水（全写为 bring your own (bottle/beer)，用于聚会请柬、餐厅告示等）

senses.def: bring your own device (a policy that allows employees in a company to bring their own laptops, etc. to work, rather than use computers provided by the company)
senses.chn: 自带设备，自携装置（全写为 bring your own device，指允许员工自带个人笔记本电脑等设备上班办公）

senses.def: a road that passes around a town or city rather than through the centre
a medical operation on the heart in which blood is directed along a different route so that it does not flow through a part that is damaged or blocked; the new route that the blood takes
senses.chn: （给心脏接旁通管的）转流术，搭桥术；旁通管

ex.en: heart bypass surgery
ex.cn: 心脏搭桥手术

ex.en: a triple bypass operation
ex.cn: 接三通管的手术

senses.def: to go around or avoid a place

ex.en: A new road now bypasses the town.
ex.cn: 一条新路绕城镇而过。

senses.def: to ignore a rule, an official system or sb in authority, especially in order to get sth done quickly
because a lot of people have asked for sth
senses.chn: 由于许多人的要求；由于普遍要求

ex.en: By popular demand, the play will run for another week.
ex.cn: 应广大观众要求，这出戏将加演一周。

senses.def: a substance that is produced during the process of making or destroying sth else

ex.en: When burnt, plastic produces dangerous by-products.
ex.cn: 塑料燃烧时产生出危险的副产品。

senses.def: a thing that happens, often unexpectedly, as the result of sth else

ex.en: One of the by-products of unemployment is an increase in crime.
ex.cn: 失业带来的一大恶果是犯罪率上升。

senses.def: a farm building in which cows are kept
a minor road
a person who sees sth that is happening but is not involved

ex.en: innocent bystanders at the scene of the accident
ex.cn: 事故现场的无辜旁观者

ex.en: Police have appealed for witnesses to the accident.
ex.cn: 警方呼吁这起事故的目击者出来作证。

ex.en: According to observers, the plane exploded shortly after take-off.
ex.cn: 据目击者说，飞机起飞后不久就爆炸了。

ex.en: A crowd of onlookers gathered at the scene of the crash.
ex.cn: 在撞车地点聚集了一大群围观者。

ex.en: Police asked passers-by if they had witnessed the accident.
ex.cn: 警察询问过路的人是否目击了这次事故。

ex.en: Three innocent bystanders were killed in the crossfire.
ex.cn: 三名无辜的旁观者在交火中丧生。

senses.def: a unit of information stored in a computer, equal to 8 bits. A computer's memory is measured in bytes.
following rules and instructions in a very strict way
senses.chn: 循规蹈矩；严格遵守章法

ex.en: She always does everything by the book.
ex.cn: 她总是照章行事。

senses.def: following closely the accepted rules for doing sth
senses.chn: 严格遵循规则；一板一眼

senses.def: there; to there

ex.en: He's over by there.
ex.cn: 他在那儿。

senses.def: for the same reasons
senses.chn: 由于同样的原因；同样地

ex.en: The penalty for failure will be high. But, by the same token, the rewards for success will be great.
ex.cn: 失败就要付出沉重的代价，同样，成功就会获得很大的回报。

by the skin of your teeth.lemma: by the skin of your teeth

senses.def: if you do sth by the skin of your teeth, you only just manage to do it
used to introduce a comment or question that is not directly related to what you have been talking about
senses.chn: 顺便提一下；捎带说一声；附带问一句

ex.en: By the way, I found that book you were looking for.
ex.cn: 顺便提一下，我找到了你在寻找的那本书。

ex.en: What's the time, by the way?
ex.cn: 顺便问一句，几点钟了？

ex.en: Oh by the way, if you see Jackie, tell her I'll call her this evening.
ex.cn: 啊，对了，你要是看到杰基，告诉她我今晚给她打电话。

senses.def: using a boat or ship
a small road that is not used very much
the less important areas of a subject
by a route that includes the place mentioned

ex.en: The artist recently arrived in Paris from Bulgaria by way of Vienna.
ex.cn: 这位艺术家最近从保加利亚途经维也纳到了巴黎。

ex.en: She came to TV by way of drama school.
ex.cn: 她是念过戏剧学校后到电视台的。

senses.def: a person or thing that is a well-known or typical example of a particular quality
senses.chn: （某种品质或特征的）代表人，代表事物，典范

ex.en: The name Chanel became a byword for elegance.
ex.cn: 香奈儿这个名字成了优雅的代名词。

senses.def: a word or phrase that is well known or often used
because people tell each other and not because they read about it

ex.en: The news spread by word of mouth.
ex.cn: 这消息是口头传开的。

senses.def: according to what you say yourself

ex.en: By his own account he had an unhappy childhood.
ex.cn: 据他自己说，他童年不快乐。

senses.def: connected with Byzantium or the Eastern Roman Empire
senses.chn: 拜占庭帝国的；东罗马帝国的

senses.def: used to describe architecture of the 5th to the 15th centuries in the Byzantine Empire, especially churches with high central domes and mosaics
senses.chn: 拜占庭建筑风格的（尤指有高穹顶和马赛克装饰的教堂）

senses.def: complicated, secret and difficult to change

ex.en: an organization of byzantine complexity
ex.cn: 拜占庭式复杂诡秘死板的机构
